note: Every row here was produced by this repository's own harness, in one dispatch of its own, against the metering proxy that also meters the reader: the same DeepSeek id for the system's own calls, the same reader prompt (`con`), the same judge and the same top-k. That is what makes the rows comparable to each other and to nothing else. A row says `n` because one of them is n=2 and a two-question row is one coin -- it is on this figure to price a mechanism, not to rank a system. The 500-question leaderboard is a different figure and this data must not be read onto it. The two `mastra` rows are one system at two settings of its own `messageTokens` trigger: the segment between them is what a tenfold lower trigger bought, and it is -4% of the cost for -3.3 points.
